page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-32 is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the x86_64 architecture. It is powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9B45 processor providing 16 physical cores and 32 virtual CPUs with simultaneous multithreading. Memory allocation totals 124.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 3.88 GB per-vCPU ratio. Hardware extensions include AVX-512 with VNNI and BF16 support, AVX-VNNI, and cryptographic instruction sets such as AES, VAES, and SHA-NI. The instance includes 32 MB of L3 cache, does not feature integrated local storage, and contains no bundled GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark evaluations reveal high single-core execution alongside strong multithreaded capacity. The platform attained a single-core Geekbench score of 2573.0 and a stress-ng single-core rating of 3451.59, both positioning in the top 10 percent of evaluated systems. Multithreaded metrics include a Geekbench multi-core score of 21625.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 56136.26. Data throughput tests show 38.0 GB/sec in single-threaded gzip compression and 206.71 GB/sec in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Large-block uncached memory read bandwidth reached 103.22 GB/sec, while write operations measured 67.85 GB/sec.

Application benchmarks reflect steady throughput across standard service tasks. The system recorded 46.42 GB/sec in static web serving throughput and executed 55.29 million operations per second during Redis SET testing. CPU-driven inference benchmarks demonstrated 461.64 tokens per second during text generation using a 135M parameter model, benefiting from vector extensions.

A primary architectural tradeoff is the absence of local NVMe storage, requiring input and output operations to rely entirely on external network persistent disks. With its balanced processor and memory profile, the c4d-standard-32 instance is engineered for enterprise web applications, software compilation pipelines, continuous integration systems, and containerized microservice deployments.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-32 is a general-purpose instance featuring 32 vCPUs and 16 physical cores driven by an AMD EPYC 9B45 processor on x86_64 architecture. The system provides 124.0 GB of dedicated RAM, providing approximately 3.88 GB per vCPU, with 32 MB of L3 cache. It incorporates advanced vector and cryptographic instruction sets, including AVX-512 (VNNI, BF16) and VAES, but contains no local storage or GPUs. Benchmark data demonstrates top-tier single-core performance alongside strong multi-core and compression processing, achieving 46.42 GB/sec in static web serving throughput and over 55 million Redis SET operations per second. Without local disks, all storage throughput relies on remote persistent volumes. The instance is suited for multi-tier enterprise web servers, CI/CD build environments, and container orchestrations requiring consistent compute and balanced memory allocations.
